title: Bo-Katan Kryze
description: Bo-Katan Kryze met Mandalorian Din Djarin when her team saved Djarin and Grogu from Quarren pirates on Trask. Djarin agreed to help Kryze raid an Imperial cruiser; Kryze gave Djarin the location of Ahsoka Tano. When Grogu was kidnapped, Kryze joined the rescue. She was angry when Djarin won the Darksaber from Moff Gideon, a prize she wanted herself.
